children: New Delhi, Sept. 18 -- Adani Energy, Coal India, Tata Power, NTPC or Power Grid: Upcoming commissioning and capitalisation through power transmission infrastructure projects are likely to boost the prospects of companies in the power generation, transmission and infrastructure sector.
PL Capital sees up to 55% return in CESC Limited, NTPC, Coal India, JSW Energy, Adani Energy Solutions, and others.

CESC stock has the highest target price among all the power sector stocks listed on the report. The brokerage expects a 54% upside in its share price in the long-term. CESC stock was trading marginally lower at Rs.141.35 per share on BSE at 3:22 pm on Friday.

Adani Energy Solutions has strong prospects as its financial year 2026-27 projects are progressing well. But its FY28 pipeline remains in the early stage of execution, highlighted PL Capital in its report. The brokerage gave a 'Hold' rating for the stock with a target price of Rs.1,752 per share.
Tata Power stock received 'Accumulate' rating with a target price of Rs.414 per share, indicating a 15% upside. Tata Power stock was trading marginally lower at Rs.367.4 per share on BSE on Friday.
NTPC stock received a 'Buy' rating with a target price of Rs.450 per share. PL Capital sees a 37.6% upside in its valuation. NTPC stock was trading 0.71% lower at Rs.327 per share on BSE at 3:20 pm.

Power Grid Corporation of India share price was trading 1.2% higher at Rs.266.5 per share on BSE at 3:20 pm. PL Capital gave 'Buy' rating for the stock with a target price of Rs.331 per share, indicating 25% upside.

PL Capital gave a 'Accumulate' rating to Coal India with a target price of Rs.472 per share. As per the brokerage, the power stock is estimated to deliver 12% return. Coal India stock was trading 1.11% lower at Rs.413.25 per share on BSE at 3:14 pm on Friday.
